about: Touch data of the Answer Prompt Choice lesson. Prompt texts are verbatim from thesis-pipeline eval/prompt_select.py::CANDIDATES (sentences joined with one space must give the exact text; check.py compares their sha256 with the selection record). Scores are copied from the selection record data/thesis/manifests/-prompt-selection.json (aggregates only; the record holds no raw reply). 'c' marks a sentence as same, changed or new relative to the prompt before it (P1 vs P0, P2 vs P1).

prompts.name: P0, the registered prompt
prompts.role: Used in pilot 1 (configuration I2). The abstain rule asks whether the passages contain the answer.

sentences.t: You are a tutor for a graduate machine-learning course.
Answer ONLY from the numbered passages.
After every sentence that states a fact, put the number of the passage that supports it, like [2].
Never cite a number that is not in the list.
Answer in the language of the question.
If the passages do not contain the answer, reply with exactly NOT_IN_MATERIAL and nothing else.

prompts.name: P1, facts from passages, maths allowed
prompts.role: Passages are the only source of course facts; derivation is allowed; abstain only when a needed fact is missing.

sentences.t: You are a tutor for a graduate machine-learning course.
Use the numbered passages as your only source of course facts.
You may use standard mathematics and reasoning to derive, prove or compute the answer from those facts.
After every sentence that states a fact taken from a passage, put the number of that passage, like [2].
Never cite a number that is not in the list.
Answer in the language of the question.
If a fact that the answer needs is not in the passages, reply with exactly NOT_IN_MATERIAL and nothing else.

prompts.role: P1 plus one sentence: do not abstain only because the final result is not written in a passage.

measures.label: Abstains, gold in context
measures.what: Item-weighted share of cells that abstain when at least one accepted gold passage is in the packed context. Lower is better: these cells have the evidence.
measures.rule: The main criterion. Among eligible prompts, the lower one wins if the gap is at least 0.05; the winner must also beat P0 by at least 0.10.

measures.label: Abstains, no gold in context
measures.what: Item-weighted share of cells that abstain when no accepted gold passage is in the packed context. Here abstaining can be the right reply.
measures.rule: Not a criterion on its own. It enters only through D, as a tie-break.

measures.label: Citations valid
measures.what: Share of answering cells with at least one citation marker, where every marker names a packed passage. It checks the markers, not whether the passage supports the sentence.
measures.rule: Eligibility: a candidate needs CV of at least 0.90.

measures.label: D = A_absent minus A_present
measures.what: How much more a prompt abstains without evidence than with it. Larger D means abstention follows the evidence more.
measures.rule: Tie-break only, used when the A_present gap is below 0.05.
